source_user: Advanced cluster case cluster scheduling and recovery-122: Design a resilient cluster scheduler for distributed LLM training and inference. Variant 122 must state assumptions, define a falsifiable hypothesis, name metrics, and include one failure or rollback condition.
source_assistant: An expert answer should distinguish model-domain mechanisms from runtime measurements. Required technical anchors: cover gang scheduling, GPU/NIC/topology-aware placement, fragmentation, preemption, checkpoint cadence, node drain, elastic restart, replica routing, SLOs, and resource accounting. It must report topology, workload, units, baselines, confounders, and evidence needed before claiming improvement.
corrected_answer: Assume node, GPU, NIC, NUMA, checkpoint-store, and replica-health inventories are authoritative only after reconciliation; policy thresholds and cluster size must be recorded rather than guessed. Hypothesis: recovery and throughput tails are driven by topology-incompatible gang placement plus unbounded retry/preemption churn after node loss. Use atomic DP/TP gang admission with GPU/NIC/topology constraints, separate requested/reserved/allocated/unavailable accounting, bounded checkpoint-safe preemption, and durable node-drain states. Fence a failed or partitioned node before revoking its lease, verify checkpoint checksum and generation, then restore the gang atomically; inference routing must require synchronized healthy replicas and shed load rather than send traffic to a recovering copy. Measure queue and placement time (s), fragmentation (%), checkpoint age/bytes and commit time (s), detection/fencing/restore/readiness times (s), lost steps, retry count, throughput (tokens/s), GPU/NIC/fabric utilization, and p50/p95/p99 latency plus error rate. Compare against a topology-aware, bounded-retry baseline and inject node, storage-delay, and stale-worker failures. Roll back the canary if it produces duplicate owners, invalid checkpoint lineage, failed gang formation, retry amplification, or predeclared recovery/SLO breaches. Evidence requires repeated end-to-end trials with scheduler, node-agent, checkpoint, fabric, and serving traces; measured facts must remain separate from estimates.
